messages:
Maya R.: Quick follow-up from last PM — we need to turn the postmortem notes into concrete runbook changes. Three actionable items I want owners for: 1) tighten triage steps + include clear one-line commands, 2) explicit escalation path (oncall -> paging -> exec + contact matrix), 3) add KV cache eviction troubleshooting + safe rollback commands. Volunteers? Prefer ETA by end of week if possible.

Jordan K.: I can take #1. Will draft a step-by-step triage flow with decision tree and minimal commands. Target: Fri EOD. @Maya R. any constraints besides idempotency and safe-by-default?

Maya R.: No other constraints. Commands should be safe to run from the jumpbox and include a dry-run where possible. Keep it compact (operators will copy-paste).

Samir P.: I'll own #2 (escalation path). I'll sync with eng-sre/oncall and make paging thresholds and escalation timing explicit. Draft by Thu.

Lina C.: I'll own #3 (KV cache eviction + rollback). I'll add stepwise commands, a circuit-breaker toggle, and an automation playbook for a safe flush. ETA Tue next week; will test in staging.

ops-bot: Created issue INC-4472 with checklist: https://redwood.example.com/issue/INC-4472 :white_check_mark:

Jordan K.: Quick note for triage snippet (will be in PR):
```bash
# find top latency hosts
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o wide
# check recent eviction logs
kubectl logs -n inference <pod> | grep "KV cache eviction"
```

Samir P.: Escalation command to include: `pagerduty trigger --service inference-slo --severity high --summary "latency spike > 99th"` — will add rule: if no ack in 15m escalate to @Lina C.. Also adding fallback model routing step to the playbook.

Lina C.: For KV eviction the safe sequence I'll document: 1) `redis-cli -h kv-cache flushdb --dry-run` 2) `curl -X POST https://internal.ops/evict?mode=safe` — and a canary roll-forward script. I'll also include a pre-check that validates cache hit ratio before running.

Maya R.: :thumbsup: One more ask — flag any action that changes live fallback policies; those require 24h heads-up to Product and CS.

Jordan K.: Noted. I'll tag policy-changes as `requires-notify` and add a minimal changelog entry in the runbook PR.

Samir P.: Observed a recurring pattern: last 3 incidents show high tail latency correlating with a sustained stream of small-batch traffic right after a model switch. I'll add a detection rule and a mitigation note tying routing fallback to that signal.

Lina C.: Test plan: I'll run the eviction flow in staging tomorrow 09:00 PST and report results here.

Jordan K.: Draft PR: https://git.redwood/inference/runbooks/pull/78 — includes triage flow, decision tree, and the one-line commands.

ops-bot: PR merged: runbooks/pull/78 by jordank. Closing checklist item: triage steps.

Maya R.: Great progress. Can everyone post a quick status update by EOD Tue? I'll collate for the follow-up review.

Samir P.: Will update escalation doc and ping Tue morning.

Lina C.: Eviction flow tested in staging — no regressions. I'll open the KV runbook PR by Tue EOD.

Maya R.: Thanks all — filing this thread under postmortem follow-ups. :sparkles:
